notes.subject: אם לא
notes.rationale: Hibru i usim 'sapos no' olsem bet bilong tok — mi tanim olsem 'Em i tru'

notes.subject: bel bilong mi
notes.rationale: נפש i klostu long 'laip/bilong mipela yet', mi usim 'bel bilong mi'

notes.subject: גמול
notes.rationale: Sampela i tok 'pikinini ol i rausim long susu', sampela i tok 'pikinini i stap yet long susu' — klos i stap long mama

translation: Em i tru, mi bin was na beltainim ⟨את⟩ bel bilong mi, olsem pikinini ol i rausim long susu bilong ⟨em⟩ mama; olsem pikinini ol i rausim pinis long susu, olsem na bel bilong mi i stap long mi.
